title: JRL Ghost Cordless Hair Trimmer

comparisons.notes: JRL Ghost 2020C clipper in white, SKU FF2020C-W, barcode 6935481304818, page shows In Stock.

writeup: Woot lists this as the JRL Ghost cordless trimmer, but the offer is tied to the JRL Ghost FF2020C-W cordless clipper in white, and Woot's own reviews describe a clipper with guards and an LED display. It is $69.99 new at Woot with a limit of 1 per customer and stock looked thin. HaircutClippers sells the same FF2020C-W clipper for $162.95, so Woot is about 57% less than that in-stock store price.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN from the Woot offer data, verified by the price checker as the JRL Ghost FF2020C-W clipper (UPC 6935481304818).
